description: Na₁₄Al₄O₁₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are seven inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.57 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.77 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.68 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.68 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.57 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.82 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.44 Å. There are two inequivalent Al sites. In the first Al site, Al is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing AlO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Al-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-1.80 Å. In the second Al site, Al is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing AlO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.78 Å) and one longer (1.82 Å) Al-O bond length. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted octahedral geometry to four Na and two equivalent Al atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Al atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Al atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Al atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Al atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Al atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two Al atoms.
